rationale: Use transactional outboxes, persistent RabbitMQ messages, durable independent queues, publisher confirms and unroutable-message detection to recover commit/publication gaps. Consumers commit deduplication and business state before manual acknowledgment. At-least-once delivery plus idempotent effects is simpler than distributed transactions or a saga platform. Configurable bounded-delay backoff, observable quarantine and authorized repair/replay preserve failures rather than masking them.
invariants: No producer reports publication complete before routing and publisher confirmation.
No consumer acknowledges successful processing before durable deduplication and state commit.
Repeated delivery never duplicates financial or registration effects; stale messages cannot regress projections.
Expired unsent payment requests are durably suppressed; in-flight late approvals require manual compensation.
Missing Billing approval never confirms a paid reservation.
Notification outages and Reporting lag cannot roll back or block registration.
Transport quarantine never cancels a pending refund obligation; automatic unlimited retries resume after repair.
Correlation, retry, outbox age and quarantine diagnostics are explicit and exclude secrets.
